src/assembly.jl:633-636: '`only` cannot reach here — a non-empty `only` of known names keeps them all' (also src/diagnostics.jl:749-750). Probe: only = ("a","b") and only = ("a",) raise no EmptyFaceSelection. An empty only counts as no selector. The code has held this since 97c63804, the commit that implemented D-251.
judgments.fix: An `except` may list every face, or a `select` may match none. An `only` passes the unknown-names check only by naming faces that exist, and it then keeps them all, so it never raises the warning.
judgments.note: D-251's rationale (log.md:10421-10423) carries the same garbled clause, '`only` naming faces that exist but a `select` that matches none', which the spec copies. The entry's Position never rules that `only` can warn.
